title: STRIDE-Z: a sliding-window persistent-homology descriptor of bilateral stride-interval geometry
description: Research code for STRIDE-Z v0.3.1: a two-dimensional point-cloud representation of paired left/right stride intervals, a Vietoris-Rips H1 persistent-homology computation (NumPy implementation), the Coordination Loop Persistence Ratio (CLPR), a synthetic benchmark, and a feasibility analysis on the PhysioNet Gait in Neurodegenerative Disease Database. Research code; not a clinical tool.
